review_comment: User-controllable data flows into a shell command through sprintf() and is executed directly via shell_exec(), creating a command injection vulnerability. The patch adds timeout handling but does not address the root cause of insufficient input sanitization. Sanitize all user inputs used in shell commands or use parameterized execution.
line_snippet: $return = shell_exec($command . " 2>&1 & ii=0 && while [ \"2\" -eq \"`ps -p $! | wc -l`\" ];do ii=$((ii+1)); if [ \$ii -gt ".($sec)."0 ]; then echo 'Intelmqctl timeout!';kill $!; break;fi; sleep 0.1; done");
